{{Quote|Stand by. Stand by…|The gunner's last words|<ref name="ANH" />}}
A '''Death Star gunner''' was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]], where they manned the battle station's [[superlaser]].<ref name="ANH" /> They participated in the [[destruction of Alderaan]] under orders from [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin]], and later [[Death|perished]] alongside [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station#Complement|over a million]] other Imperials when the station was [[Battle of Yavin|destroyed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. They hesitated while preparing to fire on the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]], buying Skywalker additional time to exploit an [[Galen Walton Erso|engineered weakness]] within the [[Death Star plans|station's design]].
